title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.1 is a public research preview of a strict structural checker for typed scientific claims. It validates rational certificate complexes, certificate-interchange defects, declared path squares, observation/query descent, product-valued hard gates, fatal dependency propagation, finite off-origin atomic-modulus records, arithmetic trace kill gates, evidence artifact hashes, and affine upper-bound propagation. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input. It does not prove a scientific claim, validate an external proof, or establish an operator realization.
